name: putpmsg
description: putpmsg is a system call intended for putting a message on a STREAMS file with a priority band, but it is not implemented in the Linux kernel.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the STREAMS file

parameters.name: ctlptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the control part of the message

parameters.name: dataptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the data part of the message

return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to ENOSYS
